def: properly, to puncture, i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
